---
title: "Functions for Dataframes"
format: live-html
engine: knitr
---

::: {.cell context='setup' autorun='false'}

```{.webr .cell-code}
download.file(
  "https://raw.githubusercontent.com/datasciencedojo/datasets/master/titanic.csv",
  "titanic.csv"
)

library(tidyverse)
df <- read_csv("titanic.csv")
```
:::





1. head()
Shows the first 6 rows of your dataframe 



::: {.cell autorun='false'}

```{.webr .cell-code}
head(df)
```
:::




To choose the number of rows you want to see, add the number of rows after the dataframe variable input. 



::: {.cell autorun='false'}

```{.webr .cell-code}
head(df, 7)
```
:::




2. dim()
Returns the number of rows and columns your dataframe has. 



::: {.cell autorun='false'}

```{.webr .cell-code}
dim(df)
```
:::




3. names()
Returns the names of the columns in your dataframe



::: {.cell autorun='false'}

```{.webr .cell-code}
names(df)
```
:::




4. summary()
Returns an overview of your dataset. 



::: {.cell autorun='false'}

```{.webr .cell-code}
summary(df)
```
:::
